# judo-meta-psm

> The PSM (Platform Specific Model) metamodel for the JUDO framework — defines the foundational data model for model-driven application development using Eclipse Modeling Framework (EMF).

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 with Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse/OSGi plugin builds)
- Multi-module project with 10 modules across metamodel, code generation, and OSGi/Eclipse distribution
- EMF (Ecore) metamodel with Epsilon (EVL) validation rules
- Code generation engine using Handlebars templates + Spring Expression Language (SpEL)
- Runs as Eclipse plugin, standalone Java library, or OSGi bundle (Karaf)
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, ecosystem context, and module architecture diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, directory structure, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, branching strategy, and submission guidelines
- [generator-maven-plugin/README.md](generator-maven-plugin/README.md): Maven plugin configuration and template system documentation
- [model/README.md](model/README.md): PSM operation behaviour reference

## Modules — Core Model

- [model/pom.xml](model/pom.xml): Eclipse plugin containing the Ecore metamodel (psm.ecore), EMF-generated Java classes, Epsilon validators, and PsmUtils
- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 tests exercising Epsilon validators against programmatically constructed models and the Northwind reference model
- [northwind-model/pom.xml](northwind-model/pom.xml): Reference PSM model based on the Northwind database schema, used across test modules

## Modules — Code Generation

- [generator-engine/pom.xml](generator-engine/pom.xml): Core generation engine reading PSM models + YAML descriptors, evaluating SpEL expressions, rendering Handlebars templates
- [generator-maven-plugin/pom.xml](generator-maven-plugin/pom.xml): Maven plugin wrapping the generator engine with goals for generate, clean, checksum, and gitignore sync
- [generator-maven-plugin-test/pom.xml](generator-maven-plugin-test/pom.xml): Integration tests for Maven plugin goal execution

## Modules — OSGi & Eclipse Distribution

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): OSGi bundle repackaging the model with PsmModelBundleTracker for automatic model discovery and service registration
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests validating OSGi bundle lifecycle and service registration
- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature packaging for P2 installation
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): Eclipse P2 update site with version-specific URLs

## Depends on

- [judo-cli-api](../judo-cli-api): CLI API contracts and caching layer decoupling CLI from metamodels
- [judo-generator-commons](../../runtime/judo-generator-commons): Handlebars template-based code generation framework
- [osgi-utils](../../runtime/osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services
- [epsilon-runtime](../../tools/epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments

## Used by

- [judo-meta-expression-psm](../judo-meta-expression-psm): Bridges Expression metamodel with PSM for type resolution and measurement support
- [judo-model-cli](../../runtime/judo-model-cli): CLI for querying and transforming JUDO models via GraphQL
- [judo-platform](../../runtime/judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-runtime-core-esm-itest](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core-esm-itest): Integration tests for ESM-to-RDBMS transformation pipeline
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core-jsl): JSL support for runtime core — model parsing through to DAOs and schema
- [judo-script-codegen](../../runtime/judo-script-codegen): Transpiles JCL scripts into executable Java source code
- [judo-services](../../runtime/judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../../runtime/judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-base](../../runtime/judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
- [judo-spring-maven-plugin](../../spring/judo-spring-maven-plugin): Maven plugin transforming JSL models into Spring Boot application code
- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs](../../template/judo-psm-generator-jaxrs): Generates JAX-RS interfaces, DTOs, and service implementations from PSM
- [judo-psm-generator-report](../../template/judo-psm-generator-report): Generates JasperReports reporting solutions from PSM models
- [judo-psm-generator-restassured](../../template/judo-psm-generator-restassured): Generates REST Assured test API clients from PSM
- [judo-psm-generator-sdk-core](../../template/judo-psm-generator-sdk-core): Generates SDK core layer — DAOs, DTOs, builders, and DI wiring from PSM
